target_customer: Learning and Development and HR teams at companies with 500+ employees (later mid-market firms with 250+)
problem: Companies want to run internal mentoring programs but matching mentors with mentees and tracking the relationships is manual and hard to scale.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for enterprise mentoring programs
product_category: Corporate mentoring and employee connection software

founders.name: Matthew Reeves
founders.background_notes: Prior employer from the YC company page. Education not listed.

founders.name: Nathan Goldstein
founders.role: Co-founder, Head of Product and Engineering
founders.background_notes: Named as a founder in the BetaKit funding story and as head of product and engineering in the Absorb announcement; the YC page lists only Reeves.

technical_complexity.rationale: A matching and tracking workflow app with Outlook and G Suite integrations; standard SaaS engineering for a small team in 2019.

defensibility.rationale: Calendar and enterprise tool integrations plus program history create some lock-in, but matching and tracking features were copyable and incumbents in mentoring software already existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A learning management system vendor, Absorb, bought Together in December 2024 to add mentorship to its LMS; Together kept operating as a standalone product at first.

market_need_then: Enterprise L&D teams were running mentoring programs by spreadsheet and email; the 2021 funding story cites enterprise customers such as Airbnb, Discovery Channel, Kellogg and Heineken, which shows paid demand by 2021. Direct evidence of demand at founding in 2018 to 2019 was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses togetherplatform.com rather than an exact together.com domain; no purchase story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, collaborative marketing copy about connection and mentoring (from the company site and blog).

rebrands.why: Absorb acquired the company; the LinkedIn page title reflects the new ownership.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a common word shared by several unrelated mentoring and community products, and no press or community activity about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Together found paying enterprise customers for corporate mentoring software, raised a small YC seed and a roughly US$5M round in December 2021, grew to about 35 people, and was acquired by the learning platform Absorb in December 2024 with all staff retained. The price was not disclosed, so whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing is unknown. The strategic logic was that mentoring fits inside a learning management system.
notes: Company site fetch was done on the acquisition blog post. Seed amount is CAD 1.8M reported as about US$1.5M by BetaKit; the December 2021 round is CAD 6.2M reported as about US$5M, closed December 2021 and published January 2022. The round was not labeled Series A by the source (a database labels it variously), so stage is other. CB Insights reports $5.1M over 5 rounds, which is lower than the BetaKit figures and unverified. Closing date of the acquisition is reported as December 10 (announcement) or December 19, 2024 (law firm record). No dated 2019 competitor sources were found; the search returned only 2026 vendor pages, so the list is empty.
